description: Polish company insolvency from the official KRS register extract (Ministry of Justice open API, live, 24 h cache): every proceeding entered since registration, open or closed: bankruptcy (upadłość), restructuring under the 2016 law, arrangement under the old law, liquidation, dissolution, suspension of activity; each with its Polish term, opening and closing dates, court and case number; plus dismissed bankruptcy petitions and protective measures. Trustees, liquidators, supervisors and debtor representatives are never named (counted in mandataires_omis). aucune_procedure means none entered in the register: a proceeding opened but not yet entered is not seen. A struck-off company is read from the full extract. A legal form off the served list (foreign entrepreneur or its branch, professional partnership) returns 404, not billed. 10-digit KRS number. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

krs.description: 10-digit Polish KRS number, leading zeros included, e.g. 0000034143

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
